# Bookstore API

## Operations

- [list_books](operations/list-books.md): List books in one genre.
- [create_book](operations/create-book.md): Add a book to the catalogue.
- [get_book](operations/get-book.md): Fetch one book by its identifier.
- [update_book](operations/update-book.md): Update the stored filters for one book.

## Schemas

- [Author](schemas/author.md)
- [Book](schemas/book.md)
- [BookFilters](schemas/book-filters.md)
- [BookFormat](schemas/book-format.md)
- [BookOrError](schemas/book-or-error.md)
- [CreatedMessage](schemas/created-message.md)
- [ListBooksResponse](schemas/list-books-response.md)
- [OutOfStock](schemas/out-of-stock.md)
